name: fragment-save-load-visual
description: Saved games draw their fragments (#1868). After a blast the player saves to slot_1 through the Saves modal, loads it back in the same page, then clicks a fragment on the muckpile and the fragment inspector opens. Before the fix a load left the scene without the loaded state's fragments, so the click found nothing. Waits are on conditions, never delays.

steps.command: new_game mine_type:desert seed:10 size:64 staffed:true cash:500000

interaction.command: new_game mine_type:desert seed:10 size:64 staffed:true cash:500000

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:3 cols:3 spacing:3 depth:8 start:18,19 diameter:0.089
steps.description: 9-hole grid, deterministic under seed 10 -- sandbox-confirmed to expose ~250 ore-bearing ground fragments alongside plenty of plain rock once blasted. diameter:0.089 added to match the real grid-tool confirm's own DEFAULT_DIAMETER_M (Drill.ts) -- an omitted diameter fell back to a different console-only default (0.15, mining.ts), desyncing drill duration/tick timing against interaction mode (same fix as rock-fragmenter-breaking.json's own drill_plan step).
#553: drain the ordered plan -- the staffed driller/drill_rig lands all 9 holes well inside this budget (sandbox-measured landing at tick 166 under real, un-cheated needs gauges).

#1774: 6 kg breakout charge (BURDEN_BREAKOUT_MAX, balance.ts) -- the 5 kg shot left the rubble sealed under the cap, and sealed rock gets no haul/fragment order, so collectedOreTotal never rose. Amount is set through its stepper so interaction mode charges the same 6 kg; stemming 2 matches DEFAULT_STEMMING_M (Charge.ts).
#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

#1801: rest-completion morale shifts the crew's pace and so the weather at blast time. Boomite is water-sensitive: a wet hole fizzles and the shot no longer breaks out (measured: 9 wet holes at tick 233, none at tick 251). Waiting for the holes to dry is what a player does; blasting is unchanged.

expect.note: a fired blast clears the plan back to zero -- nothing has been hauled anywhere yet, so collectedOreTotal is still 0 at this point

steps.description: Fire the 9-hole blast; the muckpile (ids tuned for seed 10, fragment 749 on the pile) now lies on the ground. No warehouse yet, so nothing is hauled before the save below.
#1868: save the blasted site to slot_1 through the Saves modal. Command mode stand-in is a read-only status. saveToSlot() closes the modal itself; the wait bounds the async IndexedDB write and hide.

#1868: load slot_1 in the same page through the Saves modal's Load button and confirm. The loaded state's on-ground fragments must be drawn again (before the fix the scene kept the old pile or drew none). Command mode stand-in is a read-only status.

#1868: after the load a player clicks fragment 749 on the pile (same id as fragment-inspector-visual) and the inspector opens on it. Before the fix the click failed: no fragment is on the scene to click.

expect.note: a fragment drawn from the loaded state is clickable and inspectable
